Loeb Partners Increased Holding in Jpmorgan Chase & Co (JPM) by $996,400 as Market Value Rose; Apple (AAPL) Share Price Declined While Athena Capital Advisors Has Cut Position by $719,433
May 27, 2018 - By Clifton Ray
Athena Capital Advisors Llc decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 17.32% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Athena Capital Advisors Llc sold 4,257 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The hedge fund held 20,320 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $3.44M, down from 24,577 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Athena Capital Advisors Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $926.90B market cap company. The stock increased 0.23% or $0.43 during the last trading session, reaching $188.58. About 15.45 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 27, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
Loeb Partners Corporation increased its stake in Jpmorgan Chase & Co (JPM) by 12.19% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Loeb Partners Corporation bought 9,400 shares as the company’s stock rose 0.67% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 86,500 shares of the major banks company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $9.25 million, up from 77,100 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Loeb Partners Corporation who had been investing in Jpmorgan Chase & Co for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $376.72B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.51% or $0.57 during the last trading session, reaching $110.66. About 8.28 million shares traded. JPMorgan Chase & Co. (NYSE:JPM) has risen 23.99% since May 27, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 12.44% the S&P500.
